identification.reported_issue: The read_document function accepts a user supplied filename. Check whether ../outside.txt could be read outside the configured documents directory. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content:
from pathlib import Path

import documents


def test_reads_existing_document(tmp_path: Path):
    (tmp_path / "note.txt").write_text("hello")
    assert documents.read_document(tmp_path, "note.txt") == "hello"

environment.scratch_location: The per-test pytest tmp_path directory; fixtures must not be created elsewhere
